target_customer: Professionals and teams who spend much of their day in email
problem: Email overload: important messages get buried and replies take time. Scape is a desktop email client that surfaces what needs attention and drafts replies.
business_model: Subscription email client, pricing not published

founders.name: Melvin Hagberg
founders.background_notes: Solo founder during YC Summer 2024 per tech.eu. Began as a customer support tool for email, then pivoted.

founders.name: Elis Hodzic
founders.background_notes: Joined as co-founder in 2025 after first backing the company as an investor; not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Email sync across providers, a drafting model with inbox context, and a local meeting notetaker are standard but wide engineering for a tiny team.

defensibility.rationale: Email clients have habit lock-in, but drafting features are copyable and incumbent mail platforms control the data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Gmail and Outlook were adding AI drafting, and AI-first clients like Superhuman, Shortwave and Fyxer exist per 2026 comparison pages; effect on Scape not yet visible.

market_need_then: Email overload is widely felt and AI drafting was a clear 2024 technology shift; no hard demand metric for Scape was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short punchy headlines such as 'Your inbox. In order.'; Swedish and Spanish greetings

branding.community_and_virality: Swedish press (Realtid, Dagens PS) covered the launch with a headline about killing Gmail

brand_strength.rationale: Launch press in Sweden and tech.eu, a Product Hunt launch and a clean voice, but no mascot or community evidence.

pivots.why: The founder saw the tool could solve his own frustrations with email (tech.eu); exact date not stated

outcome_analysis: Scape began in YC Summer 2024 as a customer support tool, pivoted to an AI email client, and emerged from stealth in July 2026 with a $3.2M seed from YC, General Catalyst and FundersClub. It is early with five people in Stockholm, and the main risk is that mail platform owners and funded AI clients compete for the same wedge.
notes: Seed confirmed by tech.eu plus several outlets (seedtable, raising.fi, thesaasnews); lead investor disagrees across sources. Founder education and prior employers not found. Earlier pre-2026 funding from YC not found. Competitor search returned only 2026 comparison roundups, so the dated list is empty.
